scene.title: Tremors at Dawn
scene.canon_status: provisional: written from the MC-001 cast because no Scene 001 script was supplied; replace the dialogue with canon when available

stages.objective: Find Elder Rowan in the village square
Meet Elara at the north gate
Follow the old trail to the Hollow Shrine
Examine the strange signs at the shrine
Return to Elder Rowan in the village

chatter.text: The trail used to be lined with lanterns. My grandmother said the shrine is older than the village.
Listen. No birds. They always sing up here.
If this turns out to be a bad idea, I'm telling the Elder it was yours.
See the top of the hill? Some of those stones are glowing.
Take your time. I'll keep an eye on the trail.
Check everything. The stone, the lectern, the ground. Something was here.
I keep looking back at the hill. I don't think it's done with us.
M.D... whoever you are, I hope you found your way home.
Behind you! I've got your back.

a.speaker: elder_rowan
a.text: There you are. I saw you coming up the south road.

b.speaker: elder_rowan
b.text: You felt it too, didn't you? The ground, just before dawn.

choices.text: The tremor? I thought I'd dreamed it.

c1.speaker: elder_rowan
c1.text: A shiver through the earth, deep and old. Most slept through it. The animals didn't.

c2.speaker: elder_rowan
c2.text: If it was a dream, half the village shared it. Bram swears his anvil sang.

d.speaker: elder_rowan
d.text: Tremors don't wander this valley without a reason.

e.speaker: elder_rowan
e.text: Elara keeps watch at the north gate. Go to her. She knows the old trail.

a.speaker: elara
a.text: The Elder sent you? Good. I've been staring at that hill since the shaking stopped.

b.speaker: elara
b.text: There's an old shrine up the trail. Nobody goes there anymore. But last night I'd swear I saw a light.

c1.speaker: elara
c1.text: That's what I hoped you'd say. Stay close, the trail's overgrown.

c2.speaker: elara
c2.text: Purple. Like the edge of a dream, if dreams could burn. Come on, I'd rather see it with someone.

a.speaker: elara
a.text: This lodestone wasn't cracked yesterday. Feel that? It's warm. And it's humming.

b.speaker: elara
b.text: Whatever shook the valley came from right here.

a.speaker: elara
a.text: A page, tucked under the lectern. The ink has almost faded.

b.speaker: elara
b.text: "The worlds are stacked like pages, and I have walked between them. If you find this, I was here. M.D."

actions.name: Torn Journal Page
actions.lore: "The worlds are stacked like pages,|and I have walked between them."|Signed: M.D.

c.speaker: elara
c.text: M.D.? Nobody in the village signs their name like that. Keep it safe.

a.speaker: elara
a.text: Footprints, pressed into the soul soil. They walk right to the edge of the mound...

b.speaker: elara
b.text: ...and stop. Mid-stride. As if whoever made them stepped out of the world.

a.speaker: elara
a.text: A cracked stone, a page from someone who walked between worlds, and footprints that end in the air.

b.speaker: elara
b.text: The Elder needs to hear this. Now.

a.speaker: elder_rowan
a.text: Back so soon? Your faces tell me the shrine wasn't empty.

b.speaker: elara
b.text: The lodestone is cracked, Elder. And we found this.

c.speaker: elder_rowan
c.text: "I have walked between them..." So the old tales were true. Someone has crossed before.

d.speaker: captain_maren
d.text: Elder. My patrol felt the tremor out on the ridge and saw the same light. Whatever this is, it's spreading.

e.speaker: elder_rowan
e.text: Then we prepare. Captain, double the watch. Elara, keep our new friend close.

f.speaker: elder_rowan
f.text: Whatever woke beneath that shrine is not of this world. And I fear it has noticed us.

a.speaker: bram
a.text: Morning! Mind the sparks. If you're after the Elder, he's by the well, same as every morning.

b.speaker: bram
b.text: Strange night. My anvil rang on its own around the fourth hour. Never heard it do that before.

a.speaker: orin
a.text: Fresh bread, fresh rumours. Today everyone's selling the same one: the ground shook.

b.speaker: orin
b.text: Me? Slept like a stone. Ha!

a.speaker: liora
a.text: Did you hear? Elara saw lights on the hill last night. She hasn't stopped talking about it.

a.speaker: sahir
a.text: Travellers usually come for the market. You picked a strange morning to visit.

subtitles.speaker: elder_rowan
subtitles.text: Rest while you can. Tomorrow, we find out who M.D. was.
The tremors were only the beginning.
